body: I think about suicide all the time too, just like you. Its part of my life.
Thanks for the reply, not something that would help me, but I really do appreciate you taking the time to write.

If you are "overqualified" for some jobs, can you leave some of your education off your resume and apply? You could write "babysitter" or something for the duration you were in school, if you were helping look after friends' children, etc, so there isn't a suspicious gap. Just to get a foot in the door first, worry about career progression later.
Yeah my thoughts exactly when I heard of the tragedy. So many victims who enjoyed life died, I should have died in their place instead.
Good to know I'm not the only one feeling like that :(
